playbookOutputs: CIPC annual return filing certificate / confirmation
Fee calculation showing the turnover band and any late-filing penalty
playbookCommonFailures: Turnover figure supplied is for the wrong financial year, so the wrong CIPC fee band is selected
Beneficial ownership declaration not yet filed, so CIPC blocks the annual return
Company already in 'AR Final Deregistration' status — a reinstatement is needed, not an annual return
CIPC customer account has insufficient balance for the fee plus penalty on the day of filing
Financial statements or Financial Accountability Supplement (FAS) required and not provided

informationToProvide.label: Company registration documents (e.g., CIPC documents)
informationToProvide.aiHint: Official CIPC CoR14.3, CK1, CK2 or MOI document showing company registration number, registered enterprise name and active directors. The registration number is what the filing is keyed on — extract it carefully (format YYYY/NNNNNN/07 for a company, YYYY/NNNNNN/23 for a CC).

informationToProvide.label: Turnover amount for year to be filed
informationToProvide.helpText: Total turnover (sales) for the financial year that the annual return covers. Use R0 if the company did not trade.
informationToProvide.aiHint: A Rand amount per financial year being filed. If more than one year is outstanding, one figure per year. Cross-check against AFS or management accounts if uploaded.

informationToProvide.label: Has CIPC Beneficial Ownership Been Filed Within the Last 12 Months? (Upload BO Confirmation if Available)
informationToProvide.helpText: CIPC blocks Annual Return filing unless a Beneficial Ownership declaration was filed within the last 12 months. Upload your CIPC BO Confirmation Certificate if already filed.
informationToProvide.aiHint: CIPC Beneficial Ownership Confirmation Certificate showing the enterprise registration number and filing date within the last 12 months.

informationToProvide.label: Designated Director / Compliance Officer Full Name, ID Number, Email & Cellphone (for CIPC Financial Accountability Supplement / FAS)
informationToProvide.helpText: Required by CIPC to complete the mandatory Financial Accountability Supplement (CoR 30.2) submitted alongside the Annual Return.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Collect company documents and turnover per outstanding year
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Registration number confirmed and a turnover figure supplied for every outstanding annual return year
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Look up the company on CIPC first to see how many annual return years are outstanding, then ask for a turnover figure for EACH year, not just the latest. Explain that the CIPC fee is turnover-based and is charged in addition to our R450 (the catalogue excludes CIPC fees). Ask if the client has signed AFS for the year — if the company is audited or its public interest score requires it, CIPC asks for AFS or the FAS with the return.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Verify company status and beneficial ownership compliance
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Company status is 'In Business' or 'AR Deregistration' (recoverable); BO declaration status known
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: On CIPC e-Services check the enterprise status and the annual return history. If status is 'Final Deregistration', stop and propose the Company Reinstatement service. Since 2024 CIPC requires a beneficial ownership declaration to be filed (or confirmed) before the annual return is accepted — check whether a BO filing exists for the company; if not, propose adding the Beneficial Ownership Declaration service and warn the client the AR will bounce without it. Confirm the financial year-end on the register so the correct AR year is filed.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Calculate CIPC annual return fee and penalties
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Fee per year, penalty per year and total to be paid to CIPC computed and shown to Kevin
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Apply the CIPC turnover bands per year. ⚠ verify the current fee table before relying on it: private company / CC bands are roughly: under R1m = R100, R1m to R10m = R450, R10m to R25m = R2,000, over R25m = R3,000; a late penalty (about R150 per year for a private company) applies where the return is filed more than 30 business days after the anniversary of incorporation. Non-profit companies have a lower band. Present a table: year, turnover, band, fee, penalty, total. Do not collect money from the client yourself — payment is handled by Kevin via the CIPC customer account (see cipc-annual-fees).

fulfillmentChecklist.title: File annual return(s) on CIPC e-Services
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Return staged with turnover per year and Kevin has submitted; CIPC AR certificate downloaded
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: CIPC e-Services > Transact > File Annual Returns (or the Annual Returns portal). Enter the registration number, file the oldest outstanding year first, capture turnover per year exactly as confirmed, answer the compliance checklist and the AFS/FAS questions truthfully. Confirm the customer account balance covers the total from ar_calc before submitting — the transaction fails silently on insufficient funds. Save the annual return certificate PDF and the payment receipt per year.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Deliver annual return certificate and fee breakdown
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Certificate, receipt and fee table posted to Communication History
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: State the next annual return due date (anniversary month of incorporation) and offer a reminder. Mention that the CIPC fee was paid on the client's behalf and will be invoiced as a disbursement if not already.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Final sign-off
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Kevin confirms the order can be completed
